blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators pushed back against the distillers’ idea of taxing coffee products, with Sen. Joel Villanueva saying that the move could lead to a “messy situation.” During the Senate deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Health on Friday, Sen. Pia Cayetano raised the proposal, which had been brought up by a liquor industry representative during a House hearing. The proposal was made by distillers who suggested taxing coffee instead of alcoholic beverages, arguing that younger consumers preferred coffee over liquor. House Committee on Ways and Means Chair and Marikina Rep. Miro Quimbo earlier told reporters […]... Keep on reading: Coffee tax proposal fails to perk up senators
